G0_baseline_integrity.summary: Baseline healthy, parity not-primary-blocker, and authority readable.

parity_decision.interpretation: n_action_steps parity is not the primary blocker under the current probe; later semantic gates may proceed.

G1_observation_contract.summary: Canonical observation contract requires wrist-like second camera, no overlay, no diagnostic texture, and full provenance.

G2_action_causality.summary: Carry-forward action-causality evidence remains healthy and orientation-sensitive aligned rotation beats random.

G3_state_semantics.summary: Selected telemetry-compatible candidate must be non-fraud, fully explained, materially better than M0 and eef_pose_gripper, and clear the >=0.10 gain bar.

G4a_observation_semantics.summary: Observation semantics require canonical identity, wrist-like relativeness, and no diagnostic-only visual cues.

G4b_perceptual_readability.summary: Perceptual readability requires materially improved visual gap, strong handle readability, good framing, sufficient visibility, and enough local contrast.

G5_training_eligibility.summary: Training eligibility remains downstream of all upstream contract gates and one substantive gain threshold.

route_decision_preview.why: Strongest-negative cap remains active for this cycle; stronger visual/perception reformulation still did not produce a train-eligible canonical lane.
